title: Andrew Scott Says Fleabag's Priest Gets More Recognition Than Moriarty
excerpt:
Scott says fans often mention his Fleabag character first.
The role appears to resonate even more than his Sherlock villain.
body_md:
Andrew Scott became internationally recognizable as Jim Moriarty in Sherlock, but he says another character comes up more frequently when people approach him: the priest from Fleabag's second season.

In a recent conversation, Scott identified the character often called the Hot Priest as the role audiences most readily mention. His mixture of humor, vulnerability and emotional conflict helped make the performance one of the most discussed elements of Phoebe Waller-Bridge's series.

The article also reflects on Scott's varied screen work, including Elsinore. This is not the result of a formal popularity survey; it is based on the actor's own experience of interactions with viewers.
